name: m5-type-assigner
description: Does [retronym/scala#259](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/259) (`6229a89344`: fields, mixin and the pattern matcher's stable references typed with `TypeAssigner` instead of a `Typer`) make compiles faster than its base, retronym/scala#256 at `104f789082`? Both builds are loaded with `@build=` in class loaders of their own and alternate iteration by iteration in each fork; `aa` is the base again, an A/A for the pairing's noise. Whole compile of the scala corpus (`jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`), 3 forks. m5-pro, patched JDK 26, 8G heap with a fixed 3G young generation and `-XX:hashCode=3`, a 1G code cache without flushing. Both builds compiled with the release optimizer settings.

variantDescriptions.aa: `base` again, in a third class loader
